contribution_requirements: All user-facing text goes through context.l10n / AppStrings (chrome) or context.tr(domain,key,fallback) via LocalizedCatalog (data). Service-layer generators with no BuildContext take an AppLang param resolved via L10n.read(context).lang in the screen's initState (Money Math is the reference pattern). Every new AppStrings key is added in 3 places: abstract AppStrings, EnStrings (English = exact current literal), HeStrings (Hebrew from the strings doc verbatim). Keep math/clock/money numeric amounts as LTR islands. Use LayoutBuilder not MediaQuery.size; prefer const; comic style via AppTheme.
